signature: SUBROUTINE DTRCON( NORM, UPLO, DIAG, N, A, LDA, RCOND, WORK,

params.name: norm
params.reference:
Specifies whether the 1-norm condition number or the infinity-norm condition number is required: = '1' or 'O': 1-norm;

-   `= 'I'`: Infinity-norm.

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: A is upper triangular;
-   `= 'L'`: A is lower triangular.

params.name: diag
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: A is non-unit triangular;
-   `= 'U'`: A is unit triangular.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: The triangular matrix A. If `UPLO = 'U'`, the leading N-by-N upper triangular part of the array A contains the upper triangular matrix, and the strictly lower triangular part of A is not referenced. If `UPLO = 'L'`, the leading N-by-N lower triangular part of the array A contains the lower triangular matrix, and the strictly upper triangular part of A is not referenced. If `DIAG = 'U'`, the diagonal elements of A are also not referenced and are assumed to be 1.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: rcond
params.reference: The reciprocal of the condition number of the matrix A, computed as $\mathrm{RCOND} = 1/(\operatorname{norm}(A) \, \operatorname{norm}(\operatorname{inv}(A)))$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
